documents_expected.why: call page with all the criteria

eligibility.rule: Applied for by an official representative of a conservation organisation
eligibility.quote: An official representative of the conservation organization should send an application which includes:

eligibility.rule: Research, monitoring and education grants go through an educational or non-profit institution
eligibility.quote: Applications should be made through an educational or non-profit institution.

eligibility.rule: Birds of the Carolinas and their habitats
eligibility.quote: The CBC provides grants to support research, education and conservation of birds of the Carolinas and their habitats.
Construction activities are generally not allowed (e.g. construction of boardwalks, viewing blinds, falconry facilities, rehabilitation facilities, etc.).

eligibility.rule: No indirect or general operating costs
eligibility.quote: The Carolina Bird Club does not support institutional indirect costs, or fund general operational costs of an organization.

documents.item: Purpose, actions, species and acres affected
documents.quote: Details of the purpose of the grant request; action(s) to be undertaken, species or groups of species affected, acres/units affected.
Identify the conservation need of the species or group of species for which actions are proposed
The name of the payee and the address to which a check should be mailed.

effort.step: Email the application to the Grants Committee
effort.quote: Email completed applications or inquiries to: Grants Committee

after_award.quote: Awardees must file a final report including an accounting of expenditures and a summary of the completed project no later than 30 days following its completion.
alt_quotes: Awardees must file a final report including an accounting of expenditures and a summary of research or programming no later than 30 days following the close of the grant period.

notes: Rolling. The research/education strand also needs a faculty or principal letter and a two-page scope of work; the conservation strand's list is used for documents.
